title: CYBRIK resource-bounds root closure v1
description: One terminal root record covering normal completion and cancellation through the shared closureReason vocabulary. At closure, final_consumed plus final_unused equals the closing grant's original bounds vector dimension by dimension, the root's remaining credit becomes zero, and every still-open descendant is closed with zero remaining. A root closure returns credit to nobody — the root has no parent — and mints nothing: the unused remainder is extinguished, not banked, forwarded, or re-minted. closes_descendants is fixed true so partial or selective closure is structurally unrepresentable. This record is accounting state and never a credential, capability, permission, delegation, or approval. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION — NOT IMPLEMENTED, v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA and not a bundle tag. Gate W2-H, ADR-0012.

closes_descendants.description: Closure is total. Partial or selective closure of a subtree is not expressible.
